citation: Hulme A. (1982) The wave forces acting on a floating hemisphere undergoing forced periodic oscillations, J. Fluid Mech. 121:443-463
independent_implementation: scripts/capytaine_hulme_diff_scattered.py (capytaine DiffractionProblem, scattered force) + exact Froude-Krylov quadrature from this module

normalisation.excitation_force: F / (rho g A a^2), a = 1 m, A = 1 m
normalisation.note: TensorBEM excitation_force and the Hulme reference are TOTAL (Froude-Krylov + diffraction); capytaine's diffraction force is scattered-only and is completed with the exact FK term here

geometry.body: floating hemisphere, r = a = 1 m, waterplane z = 0

provenance.note: optional dependency; only this producer script imports capytaine, the case itself reads the frozen json

convention_probe.reasoning: the long-wave limit of the TOTAL heave excitation is the wave pressure on the waterplane, pi*rho*g*a^2 (non-vanishing); a force that vanishes with ka cannot contain the incident-wave part
